summary: Five9 filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing a definitive merger agreement to acquire privately held Level AI (Ujwal, Inc.), a Delaware corporation, via reverse triangular merger through wholly owned subsidiary Lander Merger Sub. Aggregate consideration is $325.0 million in cash for Level AI's outstanding stock, options and warrants, subject to customary cash, debt, transaction-expense and net working-capital adjustments. No board recommendation or financial advisor is named, and no premium applies given the private target. Termination rights include an outside date of February 5, 2027; neither party owes a termination fee. Watch regulatory clearance and closing-condition satisfaction; no public arbitrage spread exists.
